criteria.requirement: Add wtforms.data_optional.DataOptional as opt-in Optional subclass. When raw_data is present, keep original Optional request/explicit-empty semantics, including clearing earlier processing errors for a deliberately empty request. Without submitted raw_data, use processed field.data: None/empty selected containers/empty string or configured whitespace is optional; 0 and False are real values and continue validators. Never erase an object conversion error merely because resulting data is None. Preserve old Optional untouched and use original StopValidation/field_flags/validator order. Document empty-container and whitespace policies explicitly.
